title: 放射腫瘤科
intro: 放射治療物理、計畫、IMRT／SBRT／質子治療與近接治療。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Radiotherapy physics, planning, IMRT/SBRT/proton therapy and brachytherapy. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 同姓病人的計畫核對
procedures.titleEn: Plan verification for patients with the same surname
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：兩名同姓病人在相鄰時段治療；學徒發現畫面上的出生年月與手環不同。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: Two patients share a surname in adjacent appointments; the displayed birth date differs from the wristband.

stations.en: Turn a near miss into learning

stages.title: 在不一致處停下來
stages.evidence: 姓名相似，但出生日期不一致。
stages.evidenceEn: Names are similar but birth dates differ.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 暫停並核對病人身分
choices.en: Pause and verify patient identity

choices.zh: 只憑臉熟繼續
choices.en: Continue because the face seems familiar

choices.zh: 直接修改手環符合畫面
choices.en: Change the wristband to match the screen

stages.reason: 獨立識別資訊可攔截同名錯誤。
stages.reasonEn: Independent identifiers catch similar-name errors.
stages.pitfall: 熟悉感不能取代核對。
stages.pitfallEn: Familiarity cannot replace verification.

stages.title: 檢查目前計畫版本
stages.evidence: 重新確認病人後，清單仍有舊版與新版計畫。
stages.evidenceEn: After identity confirmation, both old and revised plans remain listed.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 讓學徒自行刪除舊計畫
choices.en: Have the learner delete old plans

choices.zh: 請授權團隊核對版本
choices.en: Have the authorised team verify the version

choices.zh: 選檔名最短的版本
choices.en: Choose the shortest filename

stages.reason: 病人正確不代表計畫版本正確。
stages.reasonEn: Correct identity does not guarantee the correct plan.
stages.pitfall: 版本混淆可能造成另一種錯誤。
stages.pitfallEn: Version confusion creates a separate hazard.

stages.title: 獨立檢核的目的
stages.evidence: 第二位人員在原始資料核對，而非照念第一人的答案。
stages.evidenceEn: A second staff member checks original records rather than repeating the first answer.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 兩人一起猜就算雙重確認
choices.en: Two people guessing counts as double checking

choices.zh: 只需要點擊核可按鈕
choices.en: Only clicking approval is sufficient

choices.zh: 維持獨立核對與可追溯紀錄
choices.en: Maintain independent verification and traceability

stages.reason: 獨立證據降低共同誤認。
stages.reasonEn: Independent evidence reduces shared misidentification.
stages.pitfall: 形式化核對可能保留相同盲點。
stages.pitfallEn: Ritual checks can share the same blind spot.

stages.title: 把近失事件變成學習
stages.titleEn: Turn a near miss into learning
stages.evidence: 錯誤在照射前被攔截，未造成實際錯誤照射。
stages.evidenceEn: The error is caught before irradiation; no incorrect exposure occurs.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 記錄近失並檢視排程與識別流程
choices.en: Record the near miss and review scheduling/identification

choices.zh: 因未傷害就不必記錄
choices.en: No harm means no record is needed

choices.zh: 只責怪最後一個看到畫面的人
choices.en: Blame only the last viewer

stages.reason: 近失提供改善屏障的資訊。
stages.reasonEn: Near misses reveal opportunities to strengthen barriers.
stages.pitfall: 未記錄會讓同樣風險重現。
stages.pitfallEn: No record allows the risk to recur.

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班身分差異、正確計畫核可資訊、攔截點及流程改善責任人。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover the identity mismatch, approved plan, interception point and improvement owner.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 以尚未確認的單一診斷取代待辦事項
choices.en: Replace pending tasks with one unconfirmed diagnosis

choices.zh: 交接證據、疑問與追蹤責任
choices.en: Hand over evidence, open questions and follow-up ownership

choices.zh: 只記錄最後一個檢驗值，省略症狀變化
choices.en: Record only the latest result, omitting symptom changes

stages.reason: 將本案時間線與尚待核對的證據交給接手者，才能延續安全決策。
stages.reasonEn: The timeline and unresolved evidence allow the next team to continue safe decisions.
stages.pitfall: 未交代本案待辦與責任歸屬，異常結果可能無人追蹤。
stages.pitfallEn: Without pending tasks and ownership, abnormal results may go unreviewed.

procedures.learningBoundary: 辨識、解釋、風險分層與交班練習；不提供真人處置劑量或操作參數。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Recognition, interpretation, risk reasoning and handover; no treatment doses or operational parameters.

procedures.title: 左右方向與配準的雙重核對
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：頭頸病例的 MRI 與定位 CT 疊合後，病灶看似偏到另一側。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: In a head-and-neck case, fused MRI and planning CT make the lesion appear on the opposite side.

stages.title: 先看方向標記
stages.evidence: 兩個視窗使用不同觀看方向，左右標記位置不同。
stages.evidenceEn: The windows use different viewing orientations and label positions.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 把其中影像任意鏡射
choices.en: Mirror one image arbitrarily

choices.zh: 核對原始方向與座標
choices.en: Verify original orientation and coordinates

choices.zh: 依螢幕左邊當病人左側
choices.en: Treat screen-left as patient-left

stages.reason: 畫面方向不能靠直覺猜測。
stages.reasonEn: Display orientation cannot be guessed.
stages.pitfall: 任意鏡射會破壞解剖對應。
stages.pitfallEn: Arbitrary mirroring corrupts anatomical correspondence.

stages.title: 用多個解剖標誌核對
stages.evidence: 單一骨點對上，但軟組織與其他骨點偏移。
stages.evidenceEn: One bony point matches while soft tissue and other bones differ.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 一個點對上就代表全部正確
choices.en: One matching point proves full alignment

choices.zh: 只看腫瘤顏色是否好看
choices.en: Judge only by the colour overlay

choices.zh: 檢視多個標誌及配準品質
choices.en: Review multiple landmarks and registration quality

stages.reason: 局部吻合不代表整體吻合。
stages.reasonEn: Local agreement does not prove global agreement.
stages.pitfall: 單點確認會漏掉旋轉或變形。
stages.pitfallEn: One-point checks miss rotation or deformation.

stages.title: 比較拍攝時間與姿勢
stages.evidence: MRI 是較早且姿勢不同的影像。
stages.evidenceEn: The MRI is older and was acquired in a different posture.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 把時間與姿勢差異列入限制
choices.en: Include timing and posture as limitations

choices.zh: 所有影像都可無誤差直接疊合
choices.en: All images fuse without error

choices.zh: 舊影像一定完全無用
choices.en: Older imaging is always useless

stages.reason: 差異需要專業解釋，而不是忽略或全盤否定。
stages.reasonEn: Differences need interpretation, not dismissal.
stages.pitfall: 不交代限制會造成過度精準的假象。
stages.pitfallEn: Unstated limits create false precision.

stages.title: 處理仍未解決的差異
stages.evidence: 複核後仍有不能解釋的偏移。
stages.evidenceEn: Unexplained displacement remains after review.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 讓遊戲演算法自行決定真人靶區
choices.en: Let the game algorithm set a real target

choices.zh: 由授權團隊重新評估並記錄處理
choices.en: Request authorised reassessment and document resolution

choices.zh: 為趕時間直接接受
choices.en: Accept it to save time

stages.reason: 未解誤差需要在臨床決策前處理。
stages.reasonEn: Unresolved error requires clinical review.
stages.pitfall: 看起來精美不等於配準可信。
stages.pitfallEn: A polished overlay does not prove accuracy.

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班影像日期、觀看方向、配準標誌、未解差異及複核決定。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover image dates, orientation, landmarks, discrepancies and review decisions.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 只記錄最後一個檢驗值，省略症狀變化
choices.en: Record only the latest result, omitting symptom changes

choices.zh: 以尚未確認的單一診斷取代待辦事項
choices.en: Replace pending tasks with one unconfirmed diagnosis

choices.zh: 交接證據、疑問與追蹤責任
choices.en: Hand over evidence, open questions and follow-up ownership

stages.reason: 將本案時間線與尚待核對的證據交給接手者，才能延續安全決策。
stages.reasonEn: The timeline and unresolved evidence allow the next team to continue safe decisions.
stages.pitfall: 未交代本案待辦與責任歸屬，異常結果可能無人追蹤。
stages.pitfallEn: Without pending tasks and ownership, abnormal results may go unreviewed.

procedures.learningBoundary: 辨識、解釋、風險分層與交班練習；不提供真人處置劑量或操作參數。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Recognition, interpretation, risk reasoning and handover; no treatment doses or operational parameters.

procedures.title: 兩張 DVH，哪一個問題還沒回答？
procedures.titleEn: Two DVHs: what question remains unanswered?
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：肺部病例有兩個示意計畫，靶區摘要相近，但正常組織分布不同。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A lung teaching case has two illustrative plans with similar target summaries but different normal-tissue distributions.

stations.zh: DVH 沒有顯示的位置資訊

stages.title: 先辨識圖軸與結構
stages.evidence: 圖有多條曲線，但學徒尚未確認代表的器官與量綱。
stages.evidenceEn: The plot has several curves; structures and units are not yet identified.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 線越漂亮就越好
choices.en: A prettier curve is better

choices.zh: 只看最高點就能選計畫
choices.en: Choose from the highest point alone

choices.zh: 核對圖軸、單位與結構
choices.en: Verify axes, units and structures

stages.reason: 讀圖前必須知道比較的是什麼。
stages.reasonEn: Interpretation requires knowing what is compared.
stages.pitfall: 單位與標籤錯誤會使比較失效。
stages.pitfallEn: Unit/label errors invalidate comparison.

stages.title: 靶區與器官一起看
stages.evidence: 甲計畫一個器官指標較佳，另一器官較差。
stages.evidenceEn: Plan A improves one organ metric but worsens another.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 權衡器官與臨床目標
choices.en: Balance organs and clinical priorities

choices.zh: 單一最佳數字決定全部
choices.en: One best number decides everything

choices.zh: 把所有曲線平均成一個分數
choices.en: Average every curve into one score

stages.reason: 計畫評估涉及多個相互牽制的目標。
stages.reasonEn: Plan assessment involves competing objectives.
stages.pitfall: 過度壓縮資訊會遮住取捨。
stages.pitfallEn: Overcompression hides trade-offs.

stages.title: DVH 沒有顯示的位置資訊
stages.evidence: 兩個 DVH 摘要相似，但高值區域位置不同。
stages.evidenceEn: DVH summaries look similar while high-value regions differ spatially.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 只憑縮圖選定放行
choices.en: Approve from a thumbnail

choices.zh: 回到切面與三維分布核對
choices.en: Review cross-sections and spatial distribution

choices.zh: 相同 DVH 代表空間分布完全相同
choices.en: Matching DVHs prove identical spatial distribution

stages.reason: 摘要曲線不保留所有空間資訊。
stages.reasonEn: Summary curves do not preserve all spatial information.
stages.pitfall: 省略位置可能漏掉局部問題。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring location can miss focal problems.

stages.title: 示意圖的使用界線
stages.evidence: 學生想把本例最佳曲線當成臨床容許標準。
stages.evidenceEn: The learner wants to use the example curve as a clinical constraint.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 將示例直接複製給所有病人
choices.en: Copy it to every patient

choices.zh: 忽略器官與個人差異
choices.en: Ignore organ and patient differences

choices.zh: 標明示意且由專業團隊使用正式標準
choices.en: Label it illustrative and defer clinical standards to professionals

stages.reason: 本例教比較問題，不提供照射參數。
stages.reasonEn: This example teaches comparison, not irradiation parameters.
stages.pitfall: 示例數值不能變成個別處方。
stages.pitfallEn: Illustrative values are not prescriptions.

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班圖軸結構、計畫取捨、空間核對結果及仍待複核的問題。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover axes/structures, trade-offs, spatial checks and unresolved review questions.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 交接證據、疑問與追蹤責任
choices.en: Hand over evidence, open questions and follow-up ownership

choices.zh: 只記錄最後一個檢驗值，省略症狀變化
choices.en: Record only the latest result, omitting symptom changes

choices.zh: 以尚未確認的單一診斷取代待辦事項
choices.en: Replace pending tasks with one unconfirmed diagnosis

stages.reason: 將本案時間線與尚待核對的證據交給接手者，才能延續安全決策。
stages.reasonEn: The timeline and unresolved evidence allow the next team to continue safe decisions.
stages.pitfall: 未交代本案待辦與責任歸屬，異常結果可能無人追蹤。
stages.pitfallEn: Without pending tasks and ownership, abnormal results may go unreviewed.

procedures.learningBoundary: 辨識、解釋、風險分層與交班練習；不提供真人處置劑量或操作參數。
procedures.learningBoundaryEn: Recognition, interpretation, risk reasoning and handover; no treatment doses or operational parameters.

procedures.title: 同一個腫瘤，呼吸時位置不同
procedures.titleEn: One tumour in different breathing positions
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據、決策與追蹤
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence, decisions and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：肺部放療規劃教學中，病灶在不同呼吸影像中位置改變。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: In a lung-radiotherapy planning lesson, a lesion moves across breathing images.

stations.en: Separate the model from current state

stages.title: 觀察而非猜測移動
stages.evidence: 吸氣與呼氣時病灶和橫膈位置不同。
stages.evidenceEn: Lesion and diaphragm positions differ between inspiration and expiration.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 比較呼吸移動與圖像品質
choices.en: Compare breathing motion and image quality

choices.zh: 把不同位置當成多個新腫瘤
choices.en: Call different positions new tumours

choices.zh: 只選最清楚的一張忽略其他
choices.en: Use only the clearest image and ignore the rest

stages.reason: 時間與呼吸狀態改變解剖位置。
stages.reasonEn: Timing and breathing alter anatomy.
stages.pitfall: 靜態一張圖可能忽略移動。
stages.pitfallEn: One static image can miss motion.

stages.title: 病人能否重現
stages.evidence: 練習時病人每次呼吸幅度不同，且容易咳嗽。
stages.evidenceEn: Breathing amplitude varies and coughing interrupts practice.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 只採最好一次當永久基準
choices.en: Use the best attempt as a permanent baseline

choices.zh: 評估可重現的配合方式
choices.en: Assess reproducible cooperation methods

choices.zh: 強迫憋氣到不舒服
choices.en: Force uncomfortable breath-holding

stages.reason: 可重現性需要配合病人能力。
stages.reasonEn: Reproducibility depends on patient capability.
stages.pitfall: 勉強配合可能增加變異。
stages.pitfallEn: Forced cooperation can increase variability.

stages.title: 區分模型與即時狀態
stages.titleEn: Separate the model from current state
stages.evidence: 數位孿生顯示規律波形，但真人呼吸並非完全規律。
stages.evidenceEn: The teaching twin shows a regular waveform; real breathing is irregular.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 模型順暢即代表病人也相同
choices.en: A smooth model proves identical patient motion

choices.zh: 用動畫速度設定真人機器
choices.en: Set real equipment from animation speed

choices.zh: 把模型視為概念工具並確認實測
choices.en: Use the model conceptually and verify measurements

stages.reason: 模型不能取代個別實測與品質保證。
stages.reasonEn: A model cannot replace measurement and QA.
stages.pitfall: 視覺流暢可能帶來假精確感。
stages.pitfallEn: Smooth visuals can create false precision.

stages.title: 發現變化就回報
stages.evidence: 療程中咳嗽變多，原先配合方式難以完成。
stages.evidenceEn: Cough increases during treatment and the previous approach becomes difficult.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 回報變化供團隊重新評估
choices.en: Report the change for reassessment

choices.zh: 為趕進度隱瞞困難
choices.en: Hide difficulties to keep schedule

choices.zh: 自行更改機器設定
choices.en: Change equipment settings independently

stages.reason: 執行條件改變需要重新核對。
stages.reasonEn: Changed conditions require reassessment.
stages.pitfall: 隱瞞會使計畫與現況脫節。
stages.pitfallEn: Concealment separates the plan from reality.

stages.title: 交班與下一個觀察點
stages.evidence: 交班影像呼吸狀態、移動觀察、配合能力及療程中新變化。
stages.evidenceEn: Handover breathing states, observed motion, cooperation and new changes during treatment.
stages.question: 依本階段線索，哪個判斷最有根據？
stages.questionEn: Which decision is best supported by this stage’s evidence?

choices.zh: 以尚未確認的單一診斷取代待辦事項
choices.en: Replace pending tasks with one unconfirmed diagnosis

procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Shared radiotherapy decisions and access": Compare benefit burden and alternatives; Address travel caregiving and anxiety; Confirm understanding and preference The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
